name: o-json: read, copy and sort order rows

actions.label: Open a record detail
actions.caption: enter opens the selected order as labeled fields. Read one record without squeezing all its values into table columns.

actions.label: Remove a field from one order
actions.caption: i enters EDIT; d d deletes the id field of this record. Change the buffer deliberately without writing the source.

actions.label: Copy a whole record
actions.caption: Y copies the selected order row. Keep the entire record when one cell would omit its context.

actions.label: Copy this and the next row
actions.caption: y j copies the selected row and the row below it. Extract a short run of adjacent orders together.

actions.label: Copy this and the preceding row
actions.caption: y up copies the selected row and the one above. Include the preceding record without moving the cursor first.

actions.label: Copy the enclosing array
actions.caption: y i a copies the array containing these orders. Extract the collection without copying unrelated document metadata.

actions.label: Copy the column values
actions.caption: y i c copies the order-ID column. Build a list of identifiers without including the other fields.

actions.label: Sort by a column
actions.caption: l selects status; s s sorts the table by that column. Group orders with the same status without changing source order.

actions.label: Copy an inner key
actions.caption: y i k copies the field name. Keep the spelling of the selected key without including its value.

actions.label: Copy the column key
actions.caption: y k copies the key id. Use the exact column name while writing a query or mapping.

actions.label: Copy the enclosing object
actions.caption: y i o copies the object enclosing this ID. Keep the order context around a value you found.

actions.label: Copy an inner path
actions.caption: y i p copies the cell path with its concrete row index. Use it to locate this one value again.

actions.label: Copy the cell path
actions.caption: y p copies the concrete path of this order ID. Refer to the exact value in another tool.

actions.label: Copy the current record
actions.caption: y i r copies the current table record. Extract an order while leaving the table selection in place.

actions.label: Copy the whole table array
actions.caption: y i t copies the table array. Keep all the records represented by this table in one JSON value.

actions.label: Copy an inner value
actions.caption: y i v copies just this cell value. Use an inner object when you want the data without its surrounding key.

actions.label: Use a cell value in jq
actions.caption: ! ! places the selected value on the jq line and runs it. Start an extraction from the cell you are already inspecting.

actions.label: Change the current value
actions.caption: i c c opens this ID for change; type ORD-REVIEW and enter. Correct one value while preserving the rest of its record.

actions.label: Copy the current cell
actions.caption: y y copies the selected order ID. Reuse one value without copying the row or its path.

actions.label: Choose a column by name
actions.caption: g c opens the column chooser; type total and enter. Reach an off-screen column without counting movements.

actions.label: Jump to a numbered column
actions.caption: 3 | selects the third visible column. Use a counted column jump when you know its position.

actions.label: Move one column left
actions.caption: l selects status first; h returns to id. Move back across a wide record without changing rows.

actions.label: Move one column right
actions.caption: l moves to status. Compare neighboring fields while keeping the same order selected.

actions.label: Go to the first column
actions.caption: 0 selects the first table column. Start reading a record again from its row number.

actions.label: Go to the last column
actions.caption: $ selects the last column and brings it into view. Inspect optional fields at the far end of a wide table.

actions.label: Narrow the current column
actions.caption: z < narrows the ID column. Make room for neighboring fields when you recognize the values already.

actions.label: Widen the current column
actions.caption: z > widens the ID column. Give longer values room without changing the document.

actions.label: Pin the current column
actions.caption: z p toggles the ID column pin. Keep an identifier visible while you move across the other fields.

actions.label: Select several order rows
actions.caption: v starts a row selection; j extends it to two orders. Prepare a group for a single copy or edit operation.

actions.label: Begin a sort operation
actions.caption: s starts sorting and waits for an object. Choose a column, object or array according to what you want ordered.

actions.label: Search beyond this table
actions.caption: / opens the shared search line. Find a key or value anywhere in the document, including inside nested objects.

actions.label: Compare with the original document
actions.caption: T switches the structure and data to the original document. Compare the source view with the editable buffer.

actions.label: Go to the last order
actions.caption: G reaches the last order. Check the end of the collection without paging through every record.

actions.label: Read the next order
actions.caption: j moves down one order. Scan records while keeping the same column selected.

actions.label: Read half a screen lower
actions.caption: ctrl+d moves down half a table window. Keep some rows visible for context while scanning.

actions.label: Read half a screen higher
actions.caption: G reaches the end; ctrl+u moves half a window up. Compare the final records with the preceding group.

actions.label: Read the next screen of orders
actions.caption: ctrl+f moves down a table window. Cover a larger collection quickly while retaining the current column.

actions.label: Read the preceding screen
actions.caption: G reaches the end; ctrl+b moves up a table window. Revisit the previous group of orders.

actions.label: Go to the first order
actions.caption: home returns to the first record. Restart your scan from the beginning of the table.

actions.label: Read the preceding order
actions.caption: k moves up one order. Return to the previous record without losing your column.

actions.label: Open a value for editing
actions.caption: r enters EDIT and opens the current value editor. Inspect the old value and its type before changing it.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
